task.description: Produce a code design artefact for QRY-01 (Structured entity query surface), QRY-02 (Declared filterable field allowlist), QRY-03 (Keyset pagination with a bounded page size), and QRY-04 (Empty envelope for unauthorised entity types). All four requirements are stage 17 / PW-10 (Entity record query). Read each requirement body in full from docs/requirements.yaml before designing. The design must: (1) define the Zig types and HTTP handler signatures for POST /api/v1/entities/{entity_key}/query; (2) specify the filter/sort/pagination DSL data model; (3) define the allowlist mechanism for QRY-02; (4) define the keyset cursor scheme for QRY-03; (5) define the empty-envelope contract for QRY-04; (6) define audit event EntityQueryExecuted. No implementation code — interfaces, types, and data-flow only. Output: src/design/qry-01-04-entity-query.md.

result.summary: Design for entity query surface (QRY-01..QRY-04) — Type E. Covers: HTTP handler, FilterNode/SortNode DSL types, query compiler with positional-parameter binding, field allowlist table and resolution logic, keyset cursor with sort-fingerprint, empty-envelope contract for unauthorised/unknown entity types, EntityQueryExecuted/EntityQueryDenied audit events, tenant isolation, and SQL injection defence.
